title: We’re launching Lyria 3.5 in Google Flow Music, with advances across musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control.
excerpt: Our newest music generation model, Lyria 3.5, delivers significant advancements across musicality, lyrics, and vocal quality, empowering you to craft richer tracks. We’re rolling it out today in Google Flow Music, where we want to help you create songs you love, with creative control.Here's what’s new:Improved musicality: Create richer, more complex melodic structures that sound more natural.Enhanced lyrics: Generate higher quality lyrics with improved prompt adherence and structural awareness.Improved vocals: Bring more expression and emotion to your songs with more realistic and emotionally nuanced vocals, plus improved pronunciation.Creative control: More easily control the tempo and duration of your outputs.Try it today in Flow Music.
content_html:
Our newest music generation model, Lyria 3.5, delivers significant advancements across musicality, lyrics, and vocal quality, empowering you to craft richer tracks. We’re rolling it out today in Google Flow Music, where we want to help you create songs you love, with creative control.

Here's what’s new:

  • Improved musicality: Create richer, more complex melodic structures that sound more natural.
  • Enhanced lyrics: Generate higher quality lyrics with improved prompt adherence and structural awareness.
  • Improved vocals: Bring more expression and emotion to your songs with more realistic and emotionally nuanced vocals, plus improved pronunciation.
  • Creative control: More easily control the tempo and duration of your outputs.

Try it today in Flow Music.

content_html_zh:
我们最新的音乐生成模型 Lyria 3.5 在音乐性、歌词和声音质量方面取得了显着进步，使您能够制作更丰富的曲目。 我们今天在 Google Flow Music 中推出了它，我们希望帮助您通过创意控制来创作您喜欢的歌曲。

以下是新内容：

  • 改善音乐性：创造更丰富、更复杂的旋律结构，听起来更自然。
  • 增强歌词：生成更高质量的歌词，并提高提示依从性和结构意识。
  • 改进的声音：通过更真实和情感细腻的声音以及改进的发音，为您的歌曲带来更多的表达和情感。
  • 创意控制：更轻松地控制输出的节奏和持续时间。

今天就在 Flow Music 中尝试一下。
